sentence: The Chawama National Assembly by-election was held on 15 January 2026
context: The Chawama National Assembly by-election was held on 15 January 2026[1] to elect a Member of Parliament for the Chawama Constituency in the Lusaka District of Zambia. The by-election was won by Nundwe Bright of the FDD, who defeated Muunda Morgan of the UPND and seven other candidates
